children: rose 0.5% in Wednesday trading, closing at a record $342.96 and lifting its market value to $5.005 trillion, the first time the iPhone maker has finished a session above that threshold.
The milestone places Apple alongside Nvidia

as the only publicly traded companies to close above $5 trillion. Apple had crossed the level during regular trading on six previous occasions but failed to maintain the valuation by the closing bell.

The record comes as John Ternus leads Apple following Tim Cook's departure as chief executive in September. The company's valuation now presents a high benchmark for the new leadership as it works to sustain investor confidence and navigate competition in artificial intelligence.

Apple reached the milestone despite a broader technology sell-off on Wednesday. The Nasdaq Composite fell 1.9%, while several major technology stocks declined, leaving Apple among the few large technology names to finish higher.

title: Apple Just Made History, Joining Nvidia in the $5 Trillion Club
